title: MrChipdip's Super Mod
description: Adds a lot of new items many new bosses and weapons, currently some stuff is unfinished but is still playable.
body:
**Right now this mod is in an alpha version there is a decent amount of content right now but i plan to add a lot more.**

This mod includes some of your favorite characters from real live such as Super Diddy, Mecha Diddy and much much more.

This is the most marvelous mod i have ever created and i thought i would share it to the great people.
